# Little Westies: all listings

> Kids' activities in Melbourne's west, Victoria, Australia. Source: https://littlewesties.au/ . Generated 2026-10-24. Missing fields were not published by the source.

## Activities and places

### Tenshi-Do Cowabunga School Holiday Program
- Category: School holiday programs
- Suburb: Ravenhall, near Caroline Springs (Unit 5/94 Eucumbene Drive)
- Price: $20 half day (4 hours), $40 full day
- About: Holiday program at Tenshi-Do Martial Arts, 8.30am–5.30pm, open to students, siblings and friends: karate and gymnastics drills and games, Wii sports, movies and colouring. Book 6 days and the final 2 are free (same child). Bring lunch, snacks, a named water bottle and a change of clothes. Book by messaging the form to 0402 203 567 or tenshidoma@gmail.com.
- Source: https://tenshido.com.au/
- Last checked: 2026-10-24
